result.summary: The page is a food delivery app home screen that is largely well-structured. Found a few minor layout and content truncation issues.

issues.description: The 'Trattoria Piccol...' restaurant name in the 'Fastest near you' carousel is cut off at the right edge, along with its thumbnail image being partially clipped.
issues.suggestion: Ensure horizontal carousel items are fully visible or add proper padding/peeking to indicate scrollability without truncating text mid-word.

issues.description: The two favorite (heart) icons have inconsistent styling: one appears on a light/white circular background and the other on a dark circular background, likely due to differing image backgrounds behind them.
issues.suggestion: Apply a consistent background treatment or subtle shadow behind favorite icons to ensure uniform visibility across all cards regardless of underlying image.

issues.description: The bottom pizza card ('Popular right now' section) is cut off, showing only the top portion of the image with no restaurant name or details visible.
issues.suggestion: This is expected scroll behavior, but ensure sufficient bottom spacing so partially visible cards clearly indicate more content is available below.
